title: Kalsmritikosh sanitized real-archive manifest (MIG-001C)
description: Describes an owner-supplied SANITIZED archive for migration acceptance. The archive must contain no private user data; the manifest carries only counts, versions, ids and hashes. Consumed by ci/migrations/verify-real-archive.sh and OwnerArchiveMigrationAcceptanceTests.

originalSchemaVersion.description: The archive's PRAGMA user_version. 0 = unknown (the test records the actual value instead of enforcing it).

containsPersonalData.description: MUST be false. A fixture flagged true is refused by both the script and the test.

sourceDatabaseSHA256.description: SHA-256 of the archive's main database file (checkpointed; WAL folded in).

expectedCounts.description: table name → expected row count. At minimum files and knowledge_objects.

representative.description: At least one exact reopening anchor: a source version + its content hash (preferred), or a file id. The acceptance test fails when neither verifies.
